name: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi
summary: MIA Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi provides software development services to public and private organizations in Turkey. The company offers Pizzy, an integrated facility management software; BIO-ID, a biometric data management software; MIA-SOFT, a multimodal biometric authentication and identification software; MBIS, a multi biometric identification system; Surveillance, an environmental surveillance and face recognition system; MIA-MED, a hospital information management system software; traffic monitoring; WorkARia Zero Carbon, a carbon emission reporting technologies; and ID-100B, a multi biometric identification unit.
